race.comment: Open race to close out the card. DRIALLE (1) is one from one over this track and trip and gets some weight relief with the claim. Looms as the main danger. EZEIZA (10) missed the placings two runs back then didn't feature last start when 12 lengths away in 12th over 1300m at Toowoomba after being in contention on the bend. Is better than that and is nicely placed to take this out. ULUWATU (2) finished seventh two runs back then improved last start but found a couple better over 1500m at this circuit, beaten only 0.6 lengths after being in contention on the turn. Likely improver with strong top-three prospects. LORD DANILO (16) was solid last start when closing well from back in the run at this track and trip. Include.
